AZUSA CITY PLANNING COMMISSION
AGENDA
September 25, 2013
07:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

Use Permit No. UP-2013-04 & Design Review No. DR-2013-19 Location: 680 E. Alosta Avenue
APN: 8612-001-057
Applicant: Delta Groups Engineering Inc. forVerizon Wireless.
A request for approval of a Use Permit and Design Review, to allow the construction and operation of a stealth, roof-mounted telecommunication facility located on an existing commercial building within the University District-Mixed Use (DU-MU) zone. Staff requests the Planning Commission continue this item to the October 30, 2013, Planning Commission meeting.

2.
Design Review DR 2013-22 & Variance v 2013-02 Location: 527 Duell Street
Applicant: Jose Garcia
A request for approval of a Design Review and Variance to allow the construction of a 495 square foot room addition and a Variance to allow a reduced rear setback. This project is exempt under the California Environmental Quality Act, Section 15301(e) - Additions to existing Structures.
F2 Staff Report and Attachments
3.
General Plan Amendment No. GPA-2013-01 - Housing Element Update Location: Citywide
Applicant: City of Azusa
Consideration by the Planning Commission of a General Plan Amendment (GPA-2013-01) to update the Housing, Infrastructure, City Design, Geological Hazards, and the Open Space/Biological Resources Elements of the City of Azusa General Plan. This request includes consideration of the associated Initial Study/Negative Declaration document, which finds that the project's potential environmental effects would be less than significant. Approval of this request would be in the form of a recommendation for approval to the Azusa City Council.
